tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Free: list every data tool/endpoint with price, params and a free HTTP sample URL.

tools.name: sample
tools.description: Free: get the documented demo response for any paid tool, so you can see the exact response shape before paying. Returns fixed sample data, not a live lookup.

tools.name: nl_vehicle
tools.description: Dutch vehicle lookup — $0.020 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Registration, fuel/EV, APK (roadworthiness) and open recalls (terugroepacties) for a Dutch licence plate (kenteken).

tools.name: nl_school_holidays
tools.description: Dutch school holidays — $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Current, merged Dutch school-holiday dates, queryable by school year, region or a specific date.

tools.name: nl_vacation_region
tools.description: Vacation region resolver — $0.010 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Resolve a Dutch place to its vacation region (noord/midden/zuid) and attach that region's current holiday dates.

tools.name: nl_address
tools.description: Dutch address lookup — $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Resolve a Dutch postcode + house number to a full address (street, city, gemeente, province, WGS84 + RD coordinates), or reverse-geocode coordinates to the nearest address.

tools.name: nl_building
tools.description: Dutch building lookup (BAG) — $0.010 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Construction year (bouwjaar), floor area (oppervlakte), use function (gebruiksdoel) and status for a Dutch address, from the BAG via PDOK.

tools.name: nl_dossier
tools.description: Dutch address dossier — $0.025 per call (x402, USDC on Base). One call, four registers for a Dutch address: the address itself, its BAG building (bouwjaar, floor area, use function), its AHN height above NAP, and CBS key figures for its gemeente.

tools.name: nl_elevation
tools.description: Dutch elevation (AHN / NAP height) — $0.010 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Ground height above NAP, surface height and derived object height for a Dutch postcode or coordinate, from the AHN 0.5 m height model via PDOK.

tools.name: nl_validate
tools.description: Dutch identifier validation — $0.001 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Offline validation of a Dutch identifier: BSN (elfproef), IBAN (structure + mod-97 + bank), or kenteken (sidecode format).

tools.name: nl_demographics
tools.description: Dutch municipality demographics — $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base). CBS key figures for a Dutch municipality (population, men/women, households, average household size, population density), by gemeente name or CBS code.

tools.name: global_fx
tools.description: FX conversion (ECB) — $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base). Currency conversion using ECB euro reference rates. Informational only — not tradeable quotes.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "nl_vehicle" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
